mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (exceeding 0.5 percentage points in a single month) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (indicating labor market stress) and decline in housing starts (indicating weak consumer demand) signals a deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND HOUST falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and HOUST falls > 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-shock recovery phase, a rising industrial production index signals improving manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-shock recovery regime, INDPRO rising > 0.5% in a month is followed by negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates stronger consumer spending, which supports corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor of 20-day returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate and decrease in non-farm payrolls indicates a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to reduced consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accelerating inflation, which prompts the central bank to raise rates further, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the monetary tightening cycle, CPIAUCSL rising > 0.3% in a month is followed by positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances.
